title: Every assignment is bounded by the optimum
statement: Let $P$ be a raw constraint satisfaction instance over a nonempty finite domain, with a finite family of allowed predicates, and suppose its variable set is finite. The value of every assignment to its variables is at most the optimum value of $P$.
hypotheses_covered: The allowed predicate family is finite (part of the constraint template)
